investigations.name: simulator-benchmarking
investigations.title: simulator-benchmarking
investigations.description: Does the expression layer reproduce established simulators? Compares OdeProcess (viva-expressions) against viva-tellurium, viva-copasi and viva-pysces on the same models, ideally sourced from BioModels via viva-biomodels. One study per model class: kinetics, oscillator, and a stiff case. Shared question: trajectory agreement and computational cost. Practical outcome: guidance on when users should write expressions vs. wrap an SBML model.
